name: @ishan/ecosystem-auth
description: The optional identity sidecar for the Ishan Parihar ecosystem surfaces: a Better Auth instance built from an injected config, and an adapter that satisfies @ishan/ecosystem-core's SessionPorts port so role, tier and permission rules stay in the dependency-free core. Install-time opt-in - surfaces that do not need accounts never install it.

scripts.check:dist: npm run build && git add -A dist && git diff --quiet -- dist
scripts.verify: npm run contract && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
